mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, conversation_id, summary, covered_message_order, summary_version, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation_summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation_summary ( user_id, conversation_id, summary, covered_message_order, summary_version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{summary}, COALESCE(#{coveredMessageOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{summaryVersion}, 1), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, covered_message_order = EXCLUDED.covered_message_order, summary_version = agent_conversation_summary.summary_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXCLUDED.covered_message_order > agent_conversation_summary.covered_message_order
